summary: A guide for the second workshop day: check yesterday's fixes, give a better second demo, collect feedback, then look back on six months with evidence for every skill (an example from the capstone: 226 and 24 tests, 18 golden questions, three bugs, five gaps), write the last honest list of what you never ran, and a one-page plan for the next three months.

items.text: Check yesterday's three fixes with the preflight and the demo check
Give the final demo and write the feedback sheet for the others
Fill in your skills table with evidence you can show for each
Answer the seven looking-back questions with an example each
Write your last list of what you never ran and which you will run first
Write the one-page three-month plan with a goal you can check
Play the Look Back game to the end and see your score
